statusRules.GREEN: Good to go / no active availability concern
statusRules.YELLOW: Questionable or caution; see player/DST profile
statusRules.RED: Currently unavailable, not practicing, out, or major unit concern

Jahmyr Gibbs.label: GOOD TO GO
Jahmyr Gibbs.summary: Contract extension is complete and Gibbs is back at practice.

Bijan Robinson.label: GOOD TO GO
Bijan Robinson.summary: Robinson’s hold-in is over and there is no current contract-related practice concern.

Malik Nabers.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Malik Nabers.summary: Nabers is participating in camp while returning from his knee injury; workload and full-team participation remain worth monitoring.
Malik Nabers.fantasyImpact: Caution only; do not automatically change ADP.

Xavier Worthy.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Xavier Worthy.summary: Worthy is dealing with a shoulder issue during Chiefs camp.

DeVonta Smith.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
DeVonta Smith.summary: Smith is dealing with a hamstring issue in Eagles camp.
DeVonta Smith.fantasyImpact: Short-term caution; watch for a return to full work.

Tucker Kraft.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Tucker Kraft.summary: Kraft is practicing in his return from an ACL tear while also working without a new contract.
Tucker Kraft.fantasyImpact: Positive recovery trend, but keep the medical caution tag active.

Rashee Rice.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Rashee Rice.summary: Rice has progressed to team drills, a positive step in his return.
Rashee Rice.fantasyImpact: Trending up, but continue to monitor workload and availability.

Tua Tagovailoa.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Tua Tagovailoa.summary: Tagovailoa returned after missing time with back tightness early in Falcons camp.
Tua Tagovailoa.fantasyImpact: Currently a minor monitor rather than a major downgrade.

Michael Penix Jr..label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Michael Penix Jr..summary: Penix is not yet cleared for full team drills while recovering from his ACL injury.
Michael Penix Jr..fantasyImpact: Meaningful availability concern until full team work resumes.

Xavier Legette.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Xavier Legette.summary: Legette avoided a serious injury after a camp scare, but his health and role remain worth monitoring.
Xavier Legette.fantasyImpact: Minor caution; no automatic ADP penalty.

Jonathon Brooks.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Jonathon Brooks.summary: Camp reports are positive as Brooks works back from major knee injuries.
Jonathon Brooks.fantasyImpact: High-upside recovery profile with elevated medical risk.

Trey Benson.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Trey Benson.summary: Benson had a flare-up in his surgically repaired knee and Arizona is being cautious.
Trey Benson.fantasyImpact: Monitor workload and return to normal practice.

Mike Evans.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Mike Evans.summary: Evans has been sitting out 49ers camp work with a quad issue.
Mike Evans.fantasyImpact: Temporary red flag while he is not practicing.

Christian Kirk.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Christian Kirk.summary: Kirk has been sitting out 49ers camp work with a calf issue.
Christian Kirk.fantasyImpact: Temporary red flag while he is not practicing.

Elic Ayomanor.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Elic Ayomanor.summary: Ayomanor left Thursday practice early with a shoulder issue; the team is awaiting more information.
Elic Ayomanor.fantasyImpact: Monitor closely until the severity and practice status are clearer.

Kenyon Sadiq.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Kenyon Sadiq.summary: Sadiq has had a setback in his recovery from hernia surgery.
Kenyon Sadiq.fantasyImpact: Early-season role and availability are less certain.

Jalen McMillan.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Jalen McMillan.summary: McMillan has missed practices with a knee injury and the return timeline is uncertain.
Jalen McMillan.fantasyImpact: Meaningful draft caution until he returns to practice.

Jaylen Waddle.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Jaylen Waddle.summary: Waddle is currently sidelined with a leg strain; Sean Payton indicated a return in roughly four to five days.
Jaylen Waddle.fantasyImpact: Short-term red flag while he is not practicing.

Tank Dell.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Tank Dell.summary: Dell completed his first padded practice since 2024 in a limited capacity.
Tank Dell.fantasyImpact: Very positive recovery step, but workload remains limited.

MarShawn Lloyd.label: GOOD TO GO
MarShawn Lloyd.summary: Lloyd is healthy and participating through camp after an injury-heavy start to his career.

Bo Nix.label: GOOD TO GO
Bo Nix.summary: Nix is healthy and has looked good in Broncos camp.

Patrick Mahomes II.label: GOOD TO GO
Patrick Mahomes II.summary: Camp reporting indicates Mahomes looks fully healthy in his return from knee surgery.

A.J. Brown.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
A.J. Brown.summary: Brown disclosed a dislocated thumb from Patriots practice. He returned to practice and continued catching passes, but the injury is worth monitoring.
A.J. Brown.fantasyImpact: Minor caution while he plays through the thumb issue; no automatic ADP change.

Alec Pierce.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Alec Pierce.summary: Pierce remains on the Active/PUP list with a calf injury and did not participate in the Colts’ Aug. 6 practice.
Alec Pierce.fantasyImpact: Active availability concern until he is removed from PUP and returns to practice.

Jordan James.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Jordan James.summary: James is expected to miss time after suffering a rib fracture in 49ers practice. No firm return timetable has been announced.
Jordan James.fantasyImpact: Do not treat him as fully available until he returns to practice.

Chris Brazzell II.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
Chris Brazzell II.summary: Brazzell is expected to miss his rookie season after surgery was chosen to repair a moderate LCL tear in his left knee.
Chris Brazzell II.fantasyImpact: Remove from normal 2026 redraft consideration unless his status materially changes.

DJ Giddens.label: NOT PRACTICING / OUT
DJ Giddens.summary: Giddens did not participate in the Colts’ Aug. 6 practice because of a hamstring injury.
DJ Giddens.fantasyImpact: Short-term availability concern; monitor for return to practice.

Greg Dulcich.label: QUESTIONABLE / CAUTION
Greg Dulcich.summary: Dulcich has returned to practice in a red no-contact jersey while managing a right hand/finger issue.
Greg Dulcich.fantasyImpact: Minor caution; current reporting does not describe the injury as major.

CHI.label: MAJOR DEFENSIVE CONCERN
CHI.summary: Coby Bryant is expected to miss roughly 8–10 weeks with a knee injury, while Kyler Gordon is also on PUP.

GB.label: MAJOR DEFENSIVE CONCERN
GB.summary: Micah Parsons remains unavailable while recovering from a torn ACL and has discussed a possible in-season return rather than an immediate Week 1 return.
GB.fantasyImpact: Major pass-rush availability issue until Parsons is cleared.

ATL.label: MAJOR DEFENSIVE CONCERN
ATL.summary: Atlanta lost edge defender Jalon Walker to a torn ACL, a season-long personnel loss for the front seven.
ATL.fantasyImpact: Meaningful personnel downgrade; weekly matchup remains a separate grade.

TB.label: DEFENSIVE CAUTION
TB.summary: Vita Vea remains in a contract standoff with Tampa Bay and his agent has said a trade may result.
TB.fantasyImpact: Monitor because Vea materially affects Tampa Bay’s interior defense.

ARI.label: DEFENSIVE CAUTION
ARI.summary: Josh Sweat is currently on the PUP list, although the team has expressed confidence about his regular-season availability.
ARI.fantasyImpact: Current personnel caution, not a Week 1 matchup downgrade.

CAR.label: MAJOR DEFENSIVE CONCERN
CAR.summary: Carolina placed edge defender Nic Scourton on injured reserve after a torn ACL suffered at the start of training camp.

NO.label: MAJOR DEFENSIVE CONCERN
NO.summary: Defensive tackle Bryan Bresee suffered a season-ending ACL injury, removing a major interior contributor from the Saints defense.

CIN.label: DEFENSIVE CAUTION
CIN.summary: Shemar Stewart suffered a hyperextended knee in camp. Testing showed no ligament damage, but his return timetable remains worth monitoring.
CIN.fantasyImpact: Short-term front-seven caution rather than a season-long downgrade.

DET.label: DEFENSIVE CAUTION
DET.summary: Alim McNeill left practice with a neck injury, creating a current availability concern on Detroit’s defensive front.
DET.fantasyImpact: Monitor the interior line until McNeill’s practice status clears.
